@graph.name: Open FLEX virtual laboratory — evidence-traceable data package (Phase B M6)
@graph.description: Independent, evidence-traceable reconstruction of the original NASA Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX, ISS 2009–2011) from NASA/TP-2015-216046: Table IX and test-matrix extractions with cell-level checks, digitized Appendix B plots, registries of claims, sources and discrepancies, a single-file offline lab application, and a code-verified D²-law educational baseline (not validated against FLEX). Not a NASA product; citing NASA does not imply endorsement.

@graph.name: dataset.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: Dataset. A file of values with origin, method and processing history. Original, digitized, processed and derived data are separate datasets.

@graph.name: digitization_record.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: DigitizationRecord. How DIGITIZED series were read from a source plot: source image hash, axis calibration with residuals, detection settings, self-check, overlay, limitations.

@graph.name: discrepancy.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: Discrepancy register. Disagreements between or within sources. Values are shown as printed; 'preferred' stays null unless a documented reason exists.

@graph.name: literature_figure_case.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: LiteratureFigureCase. A case shown in a published figure (not a NASA test record). Linking it to a physical test requires a stated basis; unconfirmed links stay CANDIDATE.

@graph.name: physical_test.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: PhysicalTest. One FLEX test performed on the ISS, as documented in NASA/TP-2015-216046. Contains only printed (PUBLISHED_TABULATED) values, verbatim caption text and DERIVED comparison results; no simulated or predicted quantity may appear here.

@graph.name: shared_run.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: OpenFLEXSharedRun. A D²-law baseline simulation run packaged for posting and reproduction by others. Contains no personal data and no timestamps. A reproduction check (openflex.share.verify_run, or the app's Import) re-runs it; REPRODUCED does not mean validated.

@graph.name: simulation_run.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: SimulationRun. A model evaluation (e.g. the D²-law educational baseline). Never carries a NASA test ID as its identity; may cite the test whose printed conditions seeded its inputs, with any modification listed.

@graph.name: source.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: Source registry

@graph.name: uncertainty_component.schema.json
@graph.description: JSON Schema: Uncertainty component registry
